title: Microsoft Teams: New meeting chat experience for external participants

details.name: Summary
details.value: Microsoft Teams: New meeting chat experience for external participants

body.content:
We are updating the meeting chat experience for external participants.

When this will happen:

  • Targeted release: early November 2026
  • General availability: late November 2026

How this will affect your organization: External participants will see chat history from the time they join.

What you need to do to prepare: Review your external access policies and update your training.
